objective: increase profit by adding distribution channels only where expected value exceeds setup burden

whyNow: Microsoft states individual developer registration is free in the current onboarding flow.
Microsoft Store supports PWA pricing and discovery in 240+ countries and regions.
For non-game apps, developers may use their own commerce platform and Microsoft states the Store revenue share can be 0% for that commerce, or use Microsoft commerce with a 15% app fee.
The existing free web-tool portfolio can be packaged as PWAs and used as acquisition channels before building paid native software.

firstApp.storeBusinessModel: free acquisition app first; no ads at launch; future disclosed affiliate and relevant paid-product links only

immediate.automationGate: Initial app reservation and first submission require Partner Center product identity and age-rating completion. After the first submission, evaluate Microsoft Store submission API automation.
doNot: do not build multiple Store apps before the first one is approved
do not add affiliate links before enrollment
do not charge for a PWA that exposes the exact same premium functionality publicly

highValueNext.status: activate after base product is public or demand signal exists

tiers.rights: one purchaser / ordinary internal personal use
internal use within one organization; no redistribution
professional use in client support/projects without distributing raw editable template

highValueNext.marketEvidence: BOOTH currently contains professional Excel/software around 4,980 JPY and commercial licenses around 9,800-12,800 JPY; use only where the buyer problem and rights justify the premium.

highValueNext.status: after a product proves demand and English localization is ready
why: listing fee is currently USD 0.20 and transaction fee 6.5% before payment-processing/other applicable fees
marketplace discovery can diversify away from BOOTH/note
highValueNext.gate: do not pay listing/setup costs for unproven products; cross-list only proven products

highValueNext.why: recurring affiliate revenue can monetize digital-seller traffic without creating another paid product
highValueNext.activation: after meaningful traffic appears on digital-seller-profit or digital-store-compare, or earlier if enrollment burden is negligible

trafficFirst.rule: The largest short-term constraint is qualified traffic, not product count.
actions: Use free PWA/web tools as search and Microsoft Store acquisition surfaces.
Cap near-duplicate free tools and paid SKUs.
Once a paid URL is verified, add one context-matched CTA to the relevant free tool.
If a category shows sales, concentrate pages and products around that buyer problem instead of broadening randomly.
